scope: Independent integrity, raw-score, accounting and fixed-order review; no reserved trial executed by this audit.

methods.independence: Standard-library SHA256/AST/statistics/arithmetic and Git committed-file reads; no repository scoring, training, or verification functions called.
methods.formulas: Active=mean320 active-task centroid returns/500; previous=mean3 fresh centroid previous-phase episode means/500; combined=equal-weight sum. LA=mean4 own-phase means, F=mean3 consecutive signed differences, ZT=mean3 next-phase means; integral=y0+trapezoids, multiplied by96000 for step units. Dispersion=sample SD over independent seeds.

paper_reporting_partition_audit.scope: All manifest.json execution records with status and integer seed/trial recursively under results/ and reports/; plans/profiles excluded, duplicate publications included

continuation_review.basis: Integrity, completed whole-trial boundaries, unchanged preregistration and remaining resource budget; independent of observed scores or ranking.

limitations: Reserved validation is separate from final paper reporting.
All five preregistered seeds are complete; this single selected-rule comparison does not establish general search-method superiority.
No changes to selection, controls, objective or allocation are justified by interim outcomes.
